name: ended-null-is-refused-400
description: "ended": null is refused with HTTP 400 like any other value that is not a boolean: a null is a field that is present, not one that is absent, on both backends (#525). Only a stop that leaves the key out answers as it did before the flag existed. The attempt holds EXCLUSIVE on notes.md first, so a backend that read the null as absent would answer 200 listing it. Both backends answer in the same words.
